name: pokemon-locations-dual
description: Dual of the location encounter dataset. Nodes are PokéAPI location areas and each hyperedge represents one Pokémon, containing the location areas where that Pokémon can be encountered in at least one game version.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., pokemon-locations-dual).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

edges_metadata.pokemon_id: (LIST[INT]) PokéAPI Pokémon identifiers represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [25]).
edges_metadata.name: (LIST[STRING]) Pokémon names represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [pikachu]).
edges_metadata.species: (LIST[STRING]) Pokémon species names represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [pikachu]).
edges_metadata.generation: (LIST[STRING]) Generations where the Pokémon species were introduced represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [generation-i]).
edges_metadata.is_default: (LIST[BOOL]) Whether the represented Pokémon forms are default forms represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [true]).
edges_metadata.primary_type: (LIST[STRING]) Primary Pokémon types represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [electric]).
edges_metadata.secondary_type: (LIST[STRING]) Secondary Pokémon types when present represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [flying]).
edges_metadata.height: (LIST[INT]) Heights in PokéAPI decimetre units represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [4]).
edges_metadata.weight: (LIST[INT]) Weights in PokéAPI hectogram units represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [60]).
edges_metadata.base_hp: (LIST[INT]) Base HP stats represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [35]).
edges_metadata.base_attack: (LIST[INT]) Base attack stats represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [55]).
edges_metadata.base_defense: (LIST[INT]) Base defense stats represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [40]).
edges_metadata.base_sp_attack: (LIST[INT]) Base special attack stats represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [50]).
edges_metadata.base_sp_defense: (LIST[INT]) Base special defense stats represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [50]).
edges_metadata.base_speed: (LIST[INT]) Base speed stats represented by the hyperedge (e.g., [90]).
edges_metadata.versions: (LIST[STRING]) Game versions represented in the Pokémon location edge (e.g., [red]).
edges_metadata.encounter_methods: (LIST[STRING]) Encounter methods represented in the Pokémon location edge (e.g., [walk]).

license_note: Data derived from PokéAPI. Pokémon and Pokémon character names are trademarks of Nintendo. PokéAPI is not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, or Creatures.
